decision: The paper's own source record already exists and its hash reproduces, so it was reused and no third record was made for the same bytes. Extracted every printed cell of Table 1 (60) and Table 2 (64) from the pinned preprint XML, with the checkpoint identities taken from the pinned supplement. The version of record is a RECOMB 2025 Springer chapter whose text is paywalled; it is pinned as a companion source and recorded in a claim, and nothing was extracted from it.
gaps: Version of record paywalled; preprint and chapter not compared.
Table S1 (155 DMS Spearman cells) and Table S2 (24 ablation cells) not extracted; both are in the pinned supplement.
Figures 3a, 3b, 4, 5, 6 and S1 print no values. The OMIM regulatory comparison in Figure 3b has no printed numbers anywhere in the paper.

Three values printed in prose (Expression VEP by likelihood ratio, PhyloGPN 0.55 and Nucleotide Transformer 0.36; PhyloGPN-X Enhancer Annotation 0.03 at classifier hidden size 32) are listed in notes.md but not recorded.
No use-case judgements written; the ClinVar likelihood-ratio protocol is a candidate for the variant interpretation use cases of issue #226.
coverage_claim: Source-resolution and extraction pass for one model's own paper, cutoff 2026-11-16. Not a literature search of the genomics lane and not all-model coverage: only PhyloGPN's own paper, its supplement and its version of record were resolved.
